question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **means**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As a verb, "**means**" refers to the action of accomplishing something or using a method to achieve an objective. (किसी उद्देश्य को प्राप्त करने के लिए किसी चीज़ को पूरा करने या किसी विधि का उपयोग करने की क्रिया)

 
 
• **For example**: *He means to complete the project by the end of the week.*
 
 
 
• In the present tense, when the subject of a sentence is in the third person singular, we often add '**s**' to the base form of the verb.
 
• So, "**means**" is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• "**Calls**" often refer to the act of making a vocal sound or using a specific term to identify or summon someone or something and it does not fit grammatically in this context. (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु को पहचानने या बुलाने के लिए मुखर ध्वनि निकालने या किसी विशिष्ट शब्द का उपयोग करने की क्रिया)
 
• "**Names**" are words used to identify specific individuals, things, places, or concepts, it does not convey the same meaning as "means". (विशिष्ट व्यक्तियों, चीज़ों, स्थानों या अवधारणाओं की पहचान करना)
 
• "**Declares**" refers to the act of formally stating or making something known, it does not accurately reflect the purpose of filling in the blank. (किसी बात को औपचारिक रूप से बताने या बताने की क्रिया)
